description: MOCK ONLY registry of stub model bindings used by the deterministic mock implementation and the fixture pack. No model artifact exists, no model was trained, and no dataset was acquired. A production implementation would expose the equivalent information through GET /v1/models/current (Phase 0 §R2-6.3); that endpoint is NOT part of M1a.1 and is deliberately absent from the OpenAPI document.
x-warning: artifact_sha256 values are the SHA-256 of the empty byte string (e3b0c442...b855) and therefore denote 'no artifact'. They are placeholders so that the response shape matches the provenance contract; they are NOT hashes of any trained artifact.
x-base-value-meaning: base_value is the fixed synthetic intercept of the mock score function. It has no clinical meaning and is not a model parameter.

models.notes: Uncalibrated mock stub bound to mock_clinical_v1. Serves score.type=uncalibrated_score; the UI must not render it as a probability or a percentage (F-11).
Model-swap simulation: a new model version bound to the SAME feature schema. The contract does not change and the contract tests must still pass (F-12).
Uncalibrated mock stub bound to mock_clinical_v2. A request that names mock_clinical_v1 with this model fails with 422 schema_model_mismatch.

cohort_context.cohort_description: SYNTHETIC MOCK COHORT — no real cohort exists and no dataset was used.
cohort_context.prevalence_note: No prevalence can be stated: the mock cohort is synthetic.

models.notes: MOCK calibration branch. It exercises the calibrated_probability response shape (raw_margin, cohort_context, rendering metadata) without asserting any probability for any real population (Phase 0 §F-6).
Fail-closed simulation: the artifact is unavailable, so the endpoint must answer 503 model_unavailable and produce no score (Phase 0 §8.4).
LIME configuration branch. LIME is a local surrogate: its contributions are NOT an exact additive decomposition of the margin, so the explanation sum-check is marked not applicable (Phase 0 §R2-5.7).

explanation_configs.notes: MOCK TreeSHAP configuration. In a real deployment this id pins the explainer version, the tree-path approximation and any stability settings.
MOCK LIME configuration. The fixed seed and sampling count are part of the configuration id contract so that a LIME explanation is reproducible (Phase 0 §R2-5.7).
